title: Aeolian Hall Performing Arts Centre

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: The Aeolian is a Legendary and Historic Concert Hall. With its main floor being flat, it has wonderful flexibility for a variety of events including concerts, socials, celebrations, dances, meetings, community events and more. Besides the Main Hall, The Aeolian also offers a number of unique venues/lounges and other spaces on its ground floor. These spaces are more intimate and add flexibility to have smaller events. This Legendary and Historic Hall has seen some of the greatest legends in music grace its stage.
